headline: Up to 5 crore BDT fine: Parliament passes bill to tackle online gambling, betting
summary: The new Gambling Prevention Act replaces the 1867 law, introducing strict penalties including up to 7 years in prison for online betting and match-fixing.
details: The National Parliament has passed the Gambling Prevention Bill, 2026, introducing strict penalties for gambling, online gambling, match-fixing, and spot-fixing.

headline: 15 Forest Dept staff injured in attack during eviction drive in Gazipur
summary: A team attempting to recover encroached forest land in Sreepur was attacked by locals, leaving 15 officials injured and a government vehicle vandalised.
details: At least 15 officials and employees of the Forest Department were injured during an operation to recover encroached forest land in Sreepur upazila of Gazipur today.
The incident occurred around 12:00 pm in Sohadia village under Bormi Union when a team from the Sreepur Forest Division attempted to demolish illegal structures.
According to officials, around 40 local residents allegedly attacked the team, resulting in injuries to 15 staff members, including Sreepur Ranger Mokhlesur Rahman.
The attackers also allegedly vandalised a government vehicle used by the department during the operation.
Dr Shafiqul Islam, health and family planning officer of Sreepur Upazila Health Complex, confirmed that the 15 injured individuals were admitted to the hospital for treatment.
Sreepur Police Station OC Mohammad Shahinur Alam stated that police have been dispatched to the spot and necessary action will be taken following an investigation.
caption:
15 Forest Department officials injured and a government vehicle vandalised in Gazipur.

At least 15 officials and employees of the Forest Department were injured during an operation to recover encroached forest land in Sreepur upazila of Gazipur today.

According to officials, around 40 local residents allegedly attacked the team, resulting in injuries to 15 staff members, including Sreepur Ranger Mokhlesur Rahman.

The attackers also allegedly vandalised a government vehicle used by the department during the operation.

Dr Shafiqul Islam, health and family planning officer of Sreepur Upazila Health Complex, confirmed that the 15 injured individuals were admitted to the hospital for treatment.

Sreepur Police Station OC Mohammad Shahinur Alam stated that police have been dispatched to the spot and necessary action will be taken following an investigation.
